acceptance.given: Toolchain authority resolution is evaluated with candidate paths including a user-profile path and an explicit repository authority.

oracle.expected: Validation resolves current authority to the explicit repository authority and excludes the user-profile path.
forbidden: A user-profile path is selected as current authority.
Authority is derived from user-profile path state.
oracle.observable: Validator output records the resolved authority identity and a user-profile exclusion result.

acceptance.then: Current authority is independent of user-profile paths.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run authority-resolution validation with a user-profile path presented as an authority candidate; fail if it is selected.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce that authority resolution ignores user-profile paths and selects only the repository-authorized current authority.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; revert authority-resolution logic only.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unverified authority resolution -> validated repository authority with user-profile exclusion.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation passes only when resolved current authority is not any user-profile path.

acceptance.given: The Atomic Obligation coverage graph and assertion, selector, command, witness, and runtime-evidence nodes are assembled.

oracle.expected: Exact Cover validation reports zero orphan nodes and reciprocal participation for every covered node type.
forbidden: Any assertion, selector, command, witness, or runtime-evidence node is disconnected.
A node participates only one-way in a required relation.
oracle.observable: Validator output contains zero orphan counts for each node type and successful bidirectional relation checks.

acceptance.then: All covered nodes are connected bidirectionally to Atomic Obligations with no orphans.
acceptance.when: When the complete coverage graph is validated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute Exact Cover validation on a graph fixture containing one disconnected selector or witness node; fail with a non-zero orphan count.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate bidirectional Exact Cover across assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, and runtime evidence and reject orphan nodes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No state or schema migration; rollback is limited to validator logic.

slice_hint.state_transition: Coverage graph may contain unverified nodes -> graph passes with zero orphan counts and reciprocal links.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation succeeds iff every covered node has reciprocal Atomic Obligation participation and all orphan counts equal zero.

acceptance.given: An inspection produces effective content and a successful evidence record containing content identity metadata.

oracle.expected: Evidence validation confirms the recorded content identity exactly matches the effective inspected content that produced success.
forbidden: Successful evidence lacks a content binding.
Evidence binds to content different from the effective inspected content.
oracle.observable: Validation output shows matching content digest or canonical identity for evidence and effective content.

acceptance.then: Successful evidence is traceably bound to the effective inspected content.
acceptance.when: When successful inspection evidence is validated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run evidence validation with a successful record whose content digest differs from the effective inspected content; fail validation.

affected_subjects: Successful evidence and effective inspected content
slice_hint.behavior_change: Require successful evidence to carry and validate an exact identity binding to the effective inspected content.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Evidence schema remains compatible; rollback only removes binding enforcement.

slice_hint.state_transition: Successful evidence may be unbound or mismatched -> evidence accepted only with exact effective-content identity match.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Evidence validation passes iff success records include a content identity equal to the effective inspected content identity.

acceptance.given: The assembled Atomic Obligations and their coverage and witness relationships are loaded into the SM-1 checker.

oracle.expected: The SM-1 checker reports orphan_atomic_obligations=0 and confirms each obligation has required coverage and witnesses.
forbidden: One or more Atomic Obligations are orphaned.
Coverage or witness links are missing for any obligation.
oracle.observable: Checker output contains orphan_atomic_obligations=0 and complete per-obligation coverage and witness results.

acceptance.then: Every assembled Atomic Obligation has required bidirectional coverage and witnesses with zero orphans.
acceptance.when: When the SM-1 orphan check executes.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the SM-1 checker against a fixture omitting a required coverage or witness relation for one Atomic Obligation; fail and report a non-zero orphan count.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add explicit SM-1 validation that every Atomic Obligation has bidirectional coverage and required witnesses, reporting zero orphans only when complete.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; revert checker rule implementation.

slice_hint.state_transition: Orphan status unknown -> SM-1 checker proves zero orphan obligations with complete witnesses and coverage.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: SM-1 validation passes iff orphan_atomic_obligations equals zero and every obligation has required bidirectional coverage and witness relations.
